company.description: KOI Ride is a transportation technology platform offering airport transfers and ride-hailing services across selected destinations. It connects travelers with pre-booked private, luxury, and shared rides, ensuring convenience, reliability, and comfort. The platform focuses on seamless booking, transparent pricing, and efficient mobility solutions for both business and leisure travelers. KOI Ride provides B2B ride-hailing services for 34 countries.
